ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Assembly Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawing.

2. When learning Computer Aided Drafting and Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drafting and Design.

3. When learning Single-Phase alternating current Transformers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single-Phase alternating current Transformers.

4. When learning Lamps and Lamp Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

5. When learning Fabrication Techniques, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fabrication Techniques.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fabrication Techniques.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fabrication Techniques.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.

6. When learning Single phase Alternating Current Motors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

8. When learning Solar Photovoltaic Installation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Home- based Automatic Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Home- based Automatic Systems.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Home- based Automatic Systems.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Home- based Automatic Systems.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drafting and Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fabrication Techniques and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Career Pathways, Career Opportunities and Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Current Motors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Lamps and Lamp Circuits.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fabrication Techniques.

6. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single phase Alternating Current Motors.

7. B — Information and Communication Technology

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Solar Photovoltaic Installation.

10. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

11. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands
